strAuthor: phobosgekko; guidance adapted from Gravy/mrkmg's Auto Navigate
strNotes: Asterel modules for Polaris: N1 navigation and docking, N2 Rendezvous and Follow, N3 selected volleys and optional RCS aiming. Use Edit to place the shared flight hub. Departure checks crew, connections and clearance; avoidance uses tracked contacts. Disengage cuts thrust and leaves the ship coasting. Cease Fire keeps offensive fire on hold until Return to Native. Loading never rearms weapons. Requires Phobos Framework; disable original Auto Navigate before engagement. See the installation guide for current requirements. Adapted from Gravy/mrkmg's Auto Navigate; upstream reuse review remains pending. Unpublished development candidate; in-game evaluation pending.
